source: User-supplied final logo attachment; copied without alteration
layout: Open Cross symbol left; uppercase wordmark right
usage: Attach this exact artwork as an image reference for visible church branding. Preserve the symbol, uppercase lettering, proportions and horizontal arrangement.

vector.method: Redrawn as true vector paths from the approved PNG, then checked by overlaying it on the PNG. The symbol keeps the measured Latin cross, with the crossbar above center. ROCK SOLID uses Figtree ExtraBold outlines and CHURCH uses Montserrat SemiBold outlines, each letter placed at its measured position. Both fonts are under the SIL Open Font License, which allows outlines in a logo. The approved PNG stays the reference.

files.rock-solid-church-logo-white.svg: Full logo, white, for dark backgrounds
files.rock-solid-church-logo-transparent.png: Full logo, charcoal, 3000 pixels wide, transparent background, drawn from the SVG
files.rock-solid-church-logo-white.png: Full logo, white, 3000 pixels wide, transparent background, drawn from the SVG
files.rock-solid-church-symbol.png: Symbol only, charcoal, 1024 pixels wide, transparent background
files.rock-solid-church-symbol-white.png: Symbol only, white, 1024 pixels wide, transparent background
